name: Juan Fernando López Aguilar - Proposition de décision
title: REPORT on amendments to Parliament’s Rules of Procedure on proxy voting during pregnancy and immediately after childbirth
part_text:
Members of the European Parliament who are pregnant or have just given birth will be able to have another Member vote for them in the full Parliament. This can start up to three months before the expected birth and last up to six months after it. The proxy must be from the same political group, or another independent Member if the Member has no group. The rules only take effect once the related European Union laws are in force.

- **What changes:** A pregnant or new mother can name one proxy from her group to vote for her.
- **Who it affects:** Members of the European Parliament who are pregnant or have recently given birth.
- **What happens next:** The rules apply once the related European Union laws are in force; Parliament's office then sets the practical forms.
